The '''Bounty Hunter Armor''' was a model of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> It offered a high degree of protection against kinetic damage. However, it offered less in regards to protection from energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="SWG:CU" /> The complete armor set included helmet, chest plate, left & right biceps, left & right bracers, gloves, leg armor and boots. It was available in several different colors.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
Contrary to what its name suggested, this armor was not primary used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] but by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and criminals.<ref name="SWG" /> In fact, the Bounty Hunter Armor was known for its widespread use among members of the criminal organization of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="SWG:DWB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Death Watch Bunker|Endor}}</ref><ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref><ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Within Your Grasp"</ref><ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> It was also used by [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguards]]<ref name="SWGTCG-BEM">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Blackguard Elite Minion}}</ref> and by [[Razor Runners]].<ref name="SWGTCG-HR">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Hal Razor}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a band of spacers retrieved pieces of Bounty Hunter Armors and used them to craft their own [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armors]] in the [[Death Watch bunker]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWG" />
